query:
-- Activate all inactive Breast scenario questions
UPDATE quickfireQuestions SET isActive = 1 WHERE category = 'Breast' AND type = 'scenario' AND isActive = 0 AND deletedAt IS NULL;

-- Activate all inactive POCUS scenario questions  
UPDATE quickfireQuestions SET isActive = 1 WHERE category = 'POCUS' AND type = 'scenario' AND isActive = 0 AND deletedAt IS NULL;

-- Promote the first scheduled Breast challenge to live
UPDATE quickfireChallenges SET status = 'live', publishedAt = NOW(), updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE category = 'Breast' AND status = 'scheduled'
ORDER BY priority ASC, createdAt ASC
LIMIT 1;

-- Promote the first scheduled POCUS challenge to live
UPDATE quickfireChallenges SET status = 'live', publishedAt = NOW(), updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE category = 'POCUS' AND status = 'scheduled'
ORDER BY priority ASC, createdAt ASC
LIMIT 1;
